gen-dafont-college-gf-lexend-tera: College's curves are as heavy as its stems, with big open counters in a tall lowercase. Lexend Tera answers with a hairline plotter-pen line and wide stepping-stone spacing, so give it a modest size to keep it from sprawling.
gen-dafont-college-gf-lexend-zetta: College is the loud one, heavy-curved and authoritative, with big counters in a tall lowercase. Lexend Zetta is the sans-serif that speaks softly, in ribbon-thin strokes and wide tracking.
gen-dafont-college-gf-montserrat-alterna: Montserrat Alternates reads like chalk-board lowercase, crowding up toward the capital line, with a c as open as a bent paperclip. College's heavy curves and big counters give it a dynamic, authoritative neighbor.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-cascadia-code: Cascadia Code keeps its distance, with wire-thin monoline letters spaced out wide. Conthrax is the showpiece, geometric and wide-mouthed in its lowercase a, while the sans-serif below simply lays out a smooth, unobstructed path.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono reads as a compact skyline, curves as thick as its stems and capitals blending into lowercase like pins in a wide board. Conthrax, geometric and clean, stands taller against it.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-julius-sans-one: Conthrax has a wide-mouthed lowercase a and bodies so tall the capitals barely rise above them. Julius Sans One is the sans that exhales, with big stretches of blank space between letters and open-ended curves.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa reads with a big x-height, stubby ascenders and wide curves that stay distinct, all at a uniform thickness. Its strongest quality is how steadily it follows Conthrax's geometric, clean heading.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-lexend-giga: Modern and professional, Conthrax opens wide in its lowercase a, with capitals barely taller than the letters beside them. Lexend Giga follows with flat, single-weight linework and generous tracking that opens each word.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-lexend-mega: Conthrax has a wide-mouthed lowercase a and bodies so tall the capitals seem barely taller. Lexend Mega looks drawn with one nib and sits close to capital height, so a modest size suits this plain sans.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-lexend-peta: Professional and approachable, Lexend Peta keeps curves free of thinning and c shapes with a wide mouth. And Conthrax above it adds a geometric, clean voice that feels like following a single thread.
